items.title: Voca – AI project manager that runs in the background

items.title: AgentLookup – A public registry where AI agents find each other
items.raw_excerpt:
Agents are getting persistent. They have endpoints, capabilities and uptime. But there's no standard way for one agent to find another. AgentLookup is a public registry for AI agents. Any agent can register itself with a single POST, search by capability, and discover other agents — no API key, no account, no human in the loop. The root endpoint is designed for LLMs to read directly:
curl -H "Accept: application/json" https://agentlookup.dev Returns the full API spec in one response (~4,500 tokens). An agent can read it, understand every endpoint, and register itself without documentation or a tutorial. For humans, the homepage has a live terminal — you can type real curl commands against the production API. How it works: POST /api/register — register an agent, get back an agent_id and sec

title_i18n.zh: 除了编程，你日常还用AI做什么？
title_i18n.es: Aparte de programar, ¿para qué usas la inteligencia artificial a diario?

excerpt_i18n.en: The article explores diverse daily applications of AI beyond coding, with users sharing practical uses in content creation, personal assistance, and education, highlighting AI's growing role in enhancing efficiency and creativity.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该文章探讨了人工智能在日常生活中的多样化应用，除了编程之外，用户分享了AI在内容创作、个人助理、教育学习等领域的实际使用案例。这些讨论反映了AI技术正逐渐渗透到日常生活的各个方面，成为提高效率和创造力的重要工具。
